slices.focus: Discovering qawwali as a Sunday reset tool after a calming visit to Nusrat's
slices.summary: After a busy week, Saira visits Nusrat's for tea and discovers qawwali music creates a calming atmosphere. She decides to intentionally use qawwali for Sunday admin/paperwork as a low-noise reset ritual, and considers asking Tom for one protected quiet hour on Sundays.
open_loops: Saira hasn't yet discussed the Sunday quiet hour with Tom
The qawwali Sunday playlist needs to be created
Paperwork pile remains the resisted task she procrastinates on
decisions: Saira still listens to BBC Radio 2 in the car and old 2000s R&B for practical tasks, but qawwali now plays a larger role
